workflowRecommendation: This round is the tree's integration verification (supersedes LEGION-633). The implementer prepares the branch now (capability-row sentence and ruling, Stage 4b checkpoints repository-tools and full-agent, fixture additions, jq helpers with tests, PR body template), opens the pull request, then waits live and idle for the architect's go; the go is: #1848, #1843 and #1842 merged, the release image digest known, and for the production half the LEGION daemon rebooted onto a release carrying them (legion state --json .daemon.boots > 21). After the go it opens the operator's dispatch_ask for Stage 4a/4b at a named head and digest and runs the production-side proof over Envoy in pods of trees admitted after the reboot. Tester and reviewer cannot run the stages; they re-run what a pod can and read the operator's evidence.
